blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—United States leader Donald Trump was only Manila for 21 hours on his whirlwind Asia trip, but that was long enough for an awkward encounter with a world leaders and some local fast food. Here are three offbeat moments from the visit: The Modi shuffle A planned photo shoot with Trump and fellow leaders from Quad security alliance nations turned awkward for at least one of its participants on Wednesday when the US president turned it into an impromptu press conference. A seemingly annoyed Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi can be seen looking side to side, then lifting his right arm […]...
